name: dev-team
description: Test-first squad: the lead owns the spec, the reviewer owns every ticket, one builder writes each criterion's failing test and then its code, and the verifier blanks the implementation and watches the tests fail

members.role: Owns the spec check and every ticket; judges the tests against the spec and blanks the implementation and checks each test fails without it
Builds a ticket in red-green slices; may add tests, may never weaken one
Documents what a ticket changed, as its last stage
